name: polyprof-extension
description: PolyProf: a Cal Poly course-registration companion for comparing professors.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && vite build --config vite.background.config.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f polyprof-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist && zip -r ../polyprof-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '.*'
